import h5py, numpy as np, math

def parse_arr(ds):
    s = ds[0]
    if isinstance(s, bytes): s = s.decode()
    s = s.strip()
    return np.fromstring(s[1:-1], sep=' ')

def max_threshold_fid(xg, xe):
    """F = max_t [P_g(x<=t) + P_e(x>t)] / 2  (optimal-threshold assignment fidelity)"""
    xs = np.sort(np.concatenate([xg, xe]))
    # candidates: midpoints between consecutive sorted pooled points
    c = (xs[:-1] + xs[1:]) / 2
    cdf_g = np.searchsorted(np.sort(xg), c, side='right') / len(xg)
    sf_e  = 1 - np.searchsorted(np.sort(xe), c, side='right') / len(xe)
    F = (cdf_g + sf_e) / 2
    k = int(np.argmax(F))
    return F[k], c[k]

with h5py.File("ss_ge.h5", "r") as f:
    for i in range(1, 7):
        q = f"Q{i}"; g = f[q]
        Ig, Qg, Ie, Qe = (parse_arr(g[k]) for k in ("I_g","Q_g","I_e","Q_e"))
        ang = float(g["Angle"][0]); fid = float(g["Fidelity"][0])
        mg = np.array([np.median(Ig), np.median(Qg)]); me = np.array([np.median(Ie), np.median(Qe)])
        d = me - mg

        # variant A: stored angle, x = I cos a + Q sin a

        xgB = Ig*np.cos(ang) - Qg*np.sin(ang); xeB = Ie*np.cos(ang) - Qe*np.sin(ang)
        # variant C: separation axis from medians (sign chosen so e is higher)

import h5py, numpy as np, math

def parse_arr(ds):
    s = ds[0]
    if isinstance(s, bytes): s = s.decode()
    s = s.strip()
    return np.fromstring(s[1:-1], sep=' ')

def Phi(z): return 0.5*(1+math.erf(z/math.sqrt(2)))

def max_threshold_fid(xg, xe):
    xs = np.sort(np.concatenate([xg, xe]))
    c = (xs[:-1]+xs[1:])/2
    cdf_g = np.searchsorted(np.sort(xg), c, side='right')/len(xg)
    sf_e  = 1 - np.searchsorted(np.sort(xe), c, side='right')/len(xe)
    F = (cdf_g+sf_e)/2
    k = int(np.argmax(F))
    return F[k], c[k]

with h5py.File("ss_ge.h5", "r") as f:
    for i in range(1, 7):
        q=f"Q{i}"; g=f[q]
        Ig,Qg,Ie,Qe = (parse_arr(g[k]) for k in ("I_g","Q_g","I_e","Q_e"))
        ang=float(g["Angle"][0]); fid=float(g["Fidelity"][0])
        variants = {
            "rawI": (Ig, Ie), "rawQ": (Qg, Qe),
            "rotB": (Ig*np.cos(ang)-Qg*np.sin(ang), Ie*np.cos(ang)-Qe*np.sin(ang)),
            "rotA": (Ig*np.cos(ang)+Qg*np.sin(ang), Ie*np.cos(ang)+Qe*np.sin(ang)),
        }
        d = np.array([np.median(Ie)-np.median(Ig), np.median(Qe)-np.median(Qg)])
        u = d/np.hypot(*d)
        xgC = Ig*u[0]+Qg*u[1]; xeC = Ie*u[0]+Qe*u[1]
        if np.median(xeC)<np.median(xgC): xgC, xeC = -xgC, -xeC
        variants["sepaxis"] = (xgC, xeC)
        print(f"=== {q}  stored={fid!r}")
        for name,(xg,xe) in variants.items():
            Fmax,t = max_threshold_fid(xg,xe)
            mug,mue = xg.mean(), xe.mean(); sg,se = xg.std(), xe.std()
            # gaussian model at empirical optimal threshold
            Fg_emp_t = 0.5*(Phi((t-mug)/sg)+Phi((mue-t)/se))

import h5py, numpy as np, math

def parse_arr(ds):
    s = ds[0]
    if isinstance(s, bytes):
        s = s.decode()
    s = s.strip()
    return np.fromstring(s[1:-1], sep=' ')

with h5py.File("ss_ge.h5", "r") as f:
    data = {}
    for i in range(1, 7):
        q = "Q%d" % i
        g = f[q]
        data[q] = dict(
            Ig=parse_arr(g["I_g"]), Qg=parse_arr(g["Q_g"]),
            Ie=parse_arr(g["I_e"]), Qe=parse_arr(g["Q_e"]),
            ang=float(g["Angle"][0]), fid=float(g["Fidelity"][0]),
        )

for q, d in data.items():
    ang = d["ang"]
    variants = {
        "rawI": (d["Ig"], d["Ie"]),
        "rawQ": (d["Qg"], d["Qe"]),
        "rotB": (d["Ig"] * np.cos(ang) - d["Qg"] * np.sin(ang),
                 d["Ie"] * np.cos(ang) - d["Qe"] * np.sin(ang)),
        "rotA": (d["Ig"] * np.cos(ang) + d["Qg"] * np.sin(ang),
                 d["Ie"] * np.cos(ang) + d["Qe"] * np.sin(ang)),
    }
    dd = np.array([np.median(d["Ie"]) - np.median(d["Ig"]),
                   np.median(d["Qe"]) - np.median(d["Qg"])])
    u = dd / np.hypot(*dd)
    xg = d["Ig"] * u[0] + d["Qg"] * u[1]
    xe = d["Ie"] * u[0] + d["Qe"] * u[1]
    if np.median(xe) < np.median(xg):
        xg, xe = -xg, -xe
    variants["sepaxis"] = (xg, xe)

    target = d["fid"]
    print("=== %s stored=%.10f  stored*6000=%.4f" % (q, target, target * 6000))
    for name, (a, b) in variants.items():
        xs = np.sort(np.concatenate([a, b]))
        c = (xs[:-1] + xs[1:]) / 2
        cnt = (np.searchsorted(np.sort(a), c, side='right')
               + (len(b) - np.searchsorted(np.sort(b), c, side='right')))
        # cnt = #g<=t + #e>t ; F = cnt/6000
        for tgt in {round(target * 6000)}:
            hits = np.where(cnt == tgt)[0]
            if len(hits):
                print("   %-8s count==%d at t in [%g, %g] (e.g. t=%.4f)"
                      % (name, tgt, c[hits[0]], c[hits[-1]], c[hits[len(hits)//2]]))
        # also check swapped-label count: #g>t + #e<=t = 6000 - cnt
        hits2 = np.where((6000 - cnt) == round(target * 6000))[0]
        if len(hits2):
            print("   %-8s swapped-count==%d at t=%.4f" % (name, round(target * 6000), c[hits2[0]]))
    # is stored*6000*R integer for small R?
    for R in range(1, 60):
        v = target * 6000 * R
        if abs(v - round(v)) < 1e-6:
            print("   stored*6000*%d = %d (integer) -> stored = %d/(6000*%d)" % (R, round(v), round(v), R))
            break

        arrs = {k: parse_arr(g[k]) for k in ("I_g", "Q_g", "I_e", "Q_e")}
        naninfo = {k: int(np.isnan(v).sum()) for k, v in arrs.items()}
        ang = float(g["Angle"][0])
        fid = float(g["Fidelity"][0])
        print("=== %s stored=%.16f nan=%s" % (q, fid, naninfo))
        # candidate projections
        Ig, Qg, Ie, Qe = arrs["I_g"], arrs["Q_g"], arrs["I_e"], arrs["Q_e"]
        variants = {
            "rawI": (Ig, Ie), "rawQ": (Qg, Qe),
            "rotB": (Ig * np.cos(ang) - Qg * np.sin(ang), Ie * np.cos(ang) - Qe * np.sin(ang)),
            "rotA": (Ig * np.cos(ang) + Qg * np.sin(ang), Ie * np.cos(ang) + Qe * np.sin(ang)),
        }
        dd = np.array([np.median(Ie) - np.median(Ig), np.median(Qe) - np.median(Qg)])
        u = dd / np.hypot(*dd)
        xg, xe = Ig * u[0] + Qg * u[1], Ie * u[0] + Qe * u[1]
        if np.median(xe) < np.median(xg):
            xg, xe = -xg, -xe
        variants["sepaxis"] = (xg, xe)
        # find N and count
        Ntot = None
        for N in range(2, 12001):
            v = fid * N
            if abs(v - round(v)) < 1e-7 and N >= 5000:
                Ntot, cnt = N, round(v)
                break

        if Ntot is None:

        for name, (a, b) in variants.items():
            a2, b2 = a[~np.isnan(a)], b[~np.isnan(b)]
            xs = np.sort(np.concatenate([a2, b2]))
            c = (xs[:-1] + xs[1:]) / 2
            cnt_t = (np.searchsorted(np.sort(a2), c, side='right')

            hits = np.where(cnt_t == cnt)[0]

                specials = {"t=0": 0.0, "mid(med)": (med_a + med_b) / 2,
                            "mid(mean)": (a2.mean() + b2.mean()) / 2,
                            "med_a": med_a, "med_b": med_b, "pooled_med": np.median(np.concatenate([a2, b2]))}
                inside = [k for k, tv in specials.items() if hits[0] < np.searchsorted(c, tv) < hits[-1] + 1 and cnt_t[np.searchsorted(c, tv)] == cnt] if len(c) else []
                print("   %-8s count==%d for t in [%.4f, %.4f]; special thresholds hitting: %s"
                      % (name, cnt, c[hits[0]], c[hits[-1]], inside))

import h5py, numpy as np, math

def parse_arr(ds):
    s = ds[0]
    if isinstance(s, bytes):
        s = s.decode()
    s = s.strip()
    return np.fromstring(s[1:-1], sep=' ')

def max_threshold_fid(xg, xe):
    xs = np.sort(np.concatenate([xg, xe]))
    c = (xs[:-1] + xs[1:]) / 2
    cdf_g = np.searchsorted(np.sort(xg), c, side='right') / len(xg)
    sf_e = 1 - np.searchsorted(np.sort(xe), c, side='right') / len(xe)
    F = (cdf_g + sf_e) / 2
    return F.max()

with h5py.File("ss_ge.h5", "r") as f:
    for i in range(1, 7):
        q = "Q%d" % i
        g = f[q]
        Ig, Qg, Ie, Qe = (parse_arr(g[k]) for k in ("I_g", "Q_g", "I_e", "Q_e"))
        ang = float(g["Angle"][0])
        xg = Ig * np.cos(ang) - Qg * np.sin(ang)
        xe = Ie * np.cos(ang) - Qe * np.sin(ang)
        if np.median(xe) < np.median(xg):
            xg, xe = -xg, -xe
        mg, me = np.median(xg), np.median(xe)
        # clean sides (outer halves relative to medians)
        sgc = xg[xg <= mg].std()
        sec = xe[xe >= me].std()
        sbar_c = math.sqrt((sgc ** 2 + sec ** 2) / 2)
        sga, sea = xg.std(), xe.std()
        sbar_a = math.sqrt((sga ** 2 + sea ** 2) / 2)
        dmed = abs(me - mg)
        dmean = abs(xe.mean() - xg.mean())
        F = max_threshold_fid(xg, xe)
        print("%s: dmed=%.2f dmean=%.2f | clean: sg=%.2f se=%.2f sbar=%.2f SNR=%.3f | all: sbar=%.2f SNR=%.3f | Fmax=%.4f"
              % (q, dmed, dmean, sgc, sec, sbar_c, dmed / sbar_c, sbar_a, dmed / sbar_a, F))
        # also try clean = outer 25% and outer 75%
        for frac, lbl in [(0.25, "outer25"), (0.75, "outer75")]:
            n_g = int(len(xg) * frac)
            n_e = int(len(xe) * frac)
            sg = np.sort(xg)[:n_g].std() if me > mg else np.sort(xg)[-n_g:].std()
            se = np.sort(xe)[-n_e:].std() if me > mg else np.sort(xe)[:n_e].std()
            sb = math.sqrt((sg ** 2 + se ** 2) / 2)
            print("     %s: sg=%.2f se=%.2f SNR=%.3f" % (lbl, sg, se, dmed / sb))

import h5py, numpy as np, math

def parse_arr(ds):
    s = ds[0]
    if isinstance(s, bytes):
        s = s.decode()
    s = s.strip()
    return np.fromstring(s[1:-1], sep=' ')

def gauss_fit(x, nbins=60):
    """Fit A*exp(-(x-mu)^2/(2 s^2)) to the histogram of x via simple least squares on log? Use moment-free grid fit."""
    hist, edges = np.histogram(x, bins=nbins)
    centers = (edges[:-1] + edges[1:]) / 2
    # grid search over mu, s minimizing squared error vs hist (amplitude free)
    best = None
    mu0, s0 = x.mean(), x.std()
    for mu in np.linspace(mu0 - s0, mu0 + s0, 121):
        for s in np.linspace(0.2 * s0, 2.0 * s0, 181):
            g = np.exp(-(centers - mu) ** 2 / (2 * s ** 2))
            A = (hist @ g) / (g @ g)
            err = np.sum((hist - A * g) ** 2)
            if best is None or err < best[0]:
                best = (err, mu, s, A)
    return best[1], best[2]

def max_threshold_fid(xg, xe):
    xs = np.sort(np.concatenate([xg, xe]))
    c = (xs[:-1] + xs[1:]) / 2
    cdf_g = np.searchsorted(np.sort(xg), c, side='right') / len(xg)
    sf_e = 1 - np.searchsorted(np.sort(xe), c, side='right') / len(xe)
    return ((cdf_g + sf_e) / 2).max()

import h5py, numpy as np, math

def parse_arr(ds):
    s = ds[0]
    if isinstance(s, bytes):
        s = s.decode()
    s = s.strip()
    return np.fromstring(s[1:-1], sep=' ')

def gauss_fit(x, nbins=60):
    """Fit A*exp(-(x-mu)^2/(2 s^2)) to the histogram of x via simple least squares on log? Use moment-free grid fit."""
    hist, edges = np.histogram(x, bins=nbins)
    centers = (edges[:-1] + edges[1:]) / 2
    # grid search over mu, s minimizing squared error vs hist (amplitude free)
    best = None
    mu0, s0 = x.mean(), x.std()
    for mu in np.linspace(mu0 - s0, mu0 + s0, 121):
        for s in np.linspace(0.2 * s0, 2.0 * s0, 181):
            g = np.exp(-(centers - mu) ** 2 / (2 * s ** 2))
            A = (hist @ g) / (g @ g)
            err = np.sum((hist - A * g) ** 2)
            if best is None or err < best[0]:
                best = (err, mu, s, A)
    return best[1], best[2]

def max_threshold_fid(xg, xe):
    xs = np.sort(np.concatenate([xg, xe]))
    c = (xs[:-1] + xs[1:]) / 2
    cdf_g = np.searchsorted(np.sort(xg), c, side='right') / len(xg)
    sf_e = 1 - np.searchsorted(np.sort(xe), c, side='right') / len(xe)
    return ((cdf_g + sf_e) / 2).max()

with h5py.File("ss_ge.h5", "r") as f:
    for i in range(1, 7):

        if np.median(xe) < np.median(xg):
            xg, xe = -xg, -xe
        mug, sg = gauss_fit(xg)
        mue, se = gauss_fit(xe)
        d = abs(mue - mug)
        sbar = math.sqrt((sg ** 2 + se ** 2) / 2)
        F = max_threshold_fid(xg, xe)
        print("%s: gaussfit mug=%.1f sg=%.2f mue=%.1f se=%.2f dmu=%.2f SNR=%.3f Fmax=%.4f"

"""Reproduce the QICK Box paper Fig. 14 (single-shot readout) from ss_ge.h5 raw I/Q shots.

Method (per FERMILAB-PUB-26-0193 Sec. III C):
  - rotate (I,Q) by the stored per-qubit Angle so the g-e separation axis aligns with I:
        x = I*cos(a) - Q*sin(a),  y = I*sin(a) + Q*cos(a)
  - project onto x; readout fidelity = maximum cumulative histogram contrast
        F(t) = ( #{g: x<=t} + #{e: x>t} ) / (N_g + N_e),  F = max_t F(t)
  - binomial uncertainty  dF = sqrt(F(1-F)/N_total)
  - clean-side Gaussian cores: g samples with x <= median_g, e samples with x >= median_e
        SNR = dmu / sbar,  sbar = sqrt((sg^2+se^2)/2),  dmu = |median_e - median_g|
"""
import h5py
import numpy as np
import math
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

H5 = "ss_ge.h5"
OUT = "readout.png"


def parse_arr(ds):
    s = ds[0]
    if isinstance(s, bytes):
        s = s.decode()
    s = s.strip()
    return np.fromstring(s[1:-1], sep=" ")


def rotate(I, Q, a):
    c, s = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
    return I * c - Q * s, I * s + Q * c


def max_contrast_fid(xg, xe):
    """F = max_t [P_g(x<=t) + P_e(x>t)]/2  (maximum cumulative histogram contrast)."""
    xs = np.sort(np.concatenate([xg, xe]))
    c = (xs[:-1] + xs[1:]) / 2.0
    cdf_g = np.searchsorted(np.sort(xg), c, side="right") / len(xg)
    sf_e = 1.0 - np.searchsorted(np.sort(xe), c, side="right") / len(xe)
    F = (cdf_g + sf_e) / 2.0
    k = int(np.argmax(F))
    return float(F[k]), float(c[k])


results = {}
with h5py.File(H5, "r") as f:
    groups = [f"Q{i}" for i in range(1, 7)]
    for q in groups:
        g = f[q]
        Ig, Qg, Ie, Qe = (parse_arr(g[k]) for k in ("I_g", "Q_g", "I_e", "Q_e"))
        ang = float(g["Angle"][0])
        stored = float(g["Fidelity"][0])
        # rotate by stored angle; orient so that e sits at higher x
        xg, yg = rotate(Ig, Qg, ang)
        xe, ye = rotate(Ie, Qe, ang)
        if np.median(xe) < np.median(xg):
            xg, yg, xe, ye = -xg, -yg, -xe, -ye
        F, tstar = max_contrast_fid(xg, xe)
        dF = math.sqrt(F * (1 - F) / (len(xg) + len(xe)))
        # raw-I (unrotated) variant
        F_rawI, _ = max_contrast_fid(Ig, Ie)
        # clean-side Gaussian cores
        mg, me = float(np.median(xg)), float(np.median(xe))
        g_clean = xg[xg <= mg]
        e_clean = xe[xe >= me]
        mu_g, sg = float(g_clean.mean()), float(g_clean.std())
        mu_e, se = float(e_clean.mean()), float(e_clean.std())
        dmu = abs(me - mg)
        sbar = math.sqrt((sg ** 2 + se ** 2) / 2)
        snr = dmu / sbar
        results[q] = dict(ang=ang, stored=stored, F=F, tstar=tstar, dF=dF, F_rawI=F_rawI,
                          xg=xg, yg=yg, xe=xe, ye=ye, mg=mg, me=me,
                          mu_g=mu_g, sg=sg, mu_e=mu_e, se=se, dmu=dmu, sbar=sbar, snr=snr,
                          Ng=len(xg), Ne=len(xe))

print("%-4s %-10s %-10s %-10s %-8s %-9s %-10s" %
      ("grp", "storedFid", "F_rot", "F_rawI", "dF", "SNRclean", "dmu"))
for q, r in results.items():
    print("%-4s %-10.6f %-10.6f %-10.6f %-8.5f %-9.3f %-10.2f" %
          (q, r["stored"], r["F"], r["F_rawI"], r["dF"], r["snr"], r["dmu"]))

# ---- Fig. 14 style plot for the qubit whose recomputed fidelity matches the paper (Q1) ----
q = "Q1"
r = results[q]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 5.4), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1.15, 1]})

ax = axes[0]
ax.scatter(r["xg"], r["yg"], s=4, c="tab:blue", alpha=0.45, label="|g> (blue)", linewidths=0)
ax.scatter(r["xe"], r["ye"], s=4, c="tab:red", alpha=0.45, label="|e> (red)", linewidths=0)
ax.plot(r["mg"], np.median(r["yg"]), marker="X", ms=11, color="black", ls="none",
        label="median (black)")
ax.plot(r["me"], np.median(r["ye"]), marker="X", ms=11, color="black", ls="none")
ax.set_xlabel("rotated I  $x = I\\cos\\theta - Q\\sin\\theta$  (a.u., ADC counts)")
ax.set_ylabel("rotated Q  $y = I\\sin\\theta + Q\\cos\\theta$  (a.u.)")
ax.set_title("(a) Rotated I-Q scatter, %s (device qubit 0), N=%d per state\nrotation angle $\\theta$=%.4f rad (stored in file)"
             % (q, r["Ng"], r["ang"]))
ax.legend(loc="best", fontsize=9)

ax = axes[1]
bins = np.linspace(min(r["xg"].min(), r["xe"].min()), max(r["xg"].max(), r["xe"].max()), 81)
hg, edges, _ = ax.hist(r["xg"], bins=bins, color="tab:blue", alpha=0.55, label="|g> histogram")
he, _, _ = ax.hist(r["xe"], bins=bins, color="tab:red", alpha=0.55, label="|e> histogram")
bw = edges[1] - edges[0]
centers = (edges[:-1] + edges[1:]) / 2
# Gaussian core overlays from clean sides (dashed), scaled to histogram counts
gcurve = len(r["xg"]) * bw / (r["sg"] * math.sqrt(2 * math.pi)) * np.exp(-(centers - r["mu_g"]) ** 2 / (2 * r["sg"] ** 2))
ecurve = len(r["xe"]) * bw / (r["se"] * math.sqrt(2 * math.pi)) * np.exp(-(centers - r["mu_e"]) ** 2 / (2 * r["se"] ** 2))
ax.plot(centers, gcurve, "k--", lw=1.8, label="Gaussian core fit |g> (clean side)")
ax.plot(centers, ecurve, "k--", lw=1.8, label="Gaussian core fit |e> (clean side)")
ax.axvline(r["tstar"], color="green", ls=":", lw=1.6,
           label="optimal threshold $t^*$ = %.1f" % r["tstar"])
ax.set_xlabel("rotated I  $x$  (a.u., ADC counts)")
ax.set_ylabel("counts per bin")
ax.set_title("(b) Projected histogram along rotated I\nwith clean-side Gaussian cores")
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5, loc="best")

txt = ("$\\Delta\\mu = |\\mu_{{ee}}-\\mu_{{eg}}| = {dmu:.1f}$ a.u.   "
       "$\\sigma_g = {sg:.1f}$, $\\sigma_e = {se:.1f}$ a.u. (clean side)\n"
       "SNR $= \\Delta\\mu/\\bar\\sigma = {snr:.2f}$   "
       "readout fidelity $F = {F:.4f} \\pm {dF:.4f}$ (binomial, N=6000)\n"

import math

OUT = "readout.png"

    s = s.strip()
    return np.fromstring(s[1:-1], sep=" ")

    c, s = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
    return I * c - Q * s, I * s + Q * c

    """F = max_t [P_g(x<=t) + P_e(x>t)]/2  (maximum cumulative histogram contrast)."""
    xs = np.sort(np.concatenate([xg, xe]))
    c = (xs[:-1] + xs[1:]) / 2.0
    cdf_g = np.searchsorted(np.sort(xg), c, side="right") / len(xg)
    sf_e = 1.0 - np.searchsorted(np.sort(xe), c, side="right") / len(xe)
    F = (cdf_g + sf_e) / 2.0
    k = int(np.argmax(F))
    return float(F[k]), float(c[k])


results = {}
with h5py.File(H5, "r") as f:
    groups = [f"Q{i}" for i in range(1, 7)]
    for q in groups:
        g = f[q]
        Ig, Qg, Ie, Qe = (parse_arr(g[k]) for k in ("I_g", "Q_g", "I_e", "Q_e"))

    c, s = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)

import h5py, numpy as np, math

def parse_arr(ds):
    s = ds[0]
    if isinstance(s, bytes): s = s.decode()
    s = s.strip()
    return np.fromstring(s[1:-1], sep=' ')

def Phi(z): return 0.5*(1+math.erf(z/math.sqrt(2)))

def max_threshold_fid(xg, xe):
    xs = np.sort(np.concatenate([xg, xe]))
    c = (xs[:-1]+xs[1:])/2
    cdf_g = np.searchsorted(np.sort(xg), c, side='right')/len(xg)
    sf_e  = 1 - np.searchsorted(np.sort(xe), c, side='right')/len(xe)
    F = (cdf_g+sf_e)/2
    k = int(np.argmax(F))
    return F[k], c[k]

with h5py.File("ss_ge.h5", "r") as f:
    for i in range(1, 7):
        q=f"Q{i}"; g=f[q]
        Ig,Qg,Ie,Qe = (parse_arr(g[k]) for k in ("I_g","Q_g","I_e","Q_e"))
        ang=float(g["Angle"][0]); fid=float(g["Fidelity"][0])
        variants = {
            "rawI": (Ig, Ie), "rawQ": (Qg, Qe),
            "rotB": (Ig*np.cos(ang)-Qg*np.sin(ang), Ie*np.cos(ang)-Qe*np.sin(ang)),
            "rotA": (Ig*np.cos(ang)+Qg*np.sin(ang), Ie*np.cos(ang)+Qe*np.sin(ang)),
        }
        d = np.array([np.median(Ie)-np.median(Ig), np.median(Qe)-np.median(Qg)])
        u = d/np.hypot(*d)
        xgC = Ig*u[0]+Qg*u[1]; xeC = Ie*u[0]+Qe*u[1]
        if np.median(xeC)<np.median(xgC): xgC, xeC = -xgC, -xeC
        variants["sepaxis"] = (xgC, xeC)
        print(f"=== {q}  stored={fid!r}")
        for name,(xg,xe) in variants.items():
            Fmax,t = max_threshold_fid(xg,xe)
            mug,mue = xg.mean(), xe.mean(); sg,se = xg.std(), xe.std()
            # gaussian model at empirical optimal threshold
            Fg_emp_t = 0.5*(Phi((t-mug)/sg)+Phi((mue-t)/se))
            # gaussian model at midpoint
            tm=(mug+mue)/2
            Fg_mid = 0.5*(Phi((tm-mug)/sg)+Phi((mue-tm)/se))
            # clean-side
            mg,me = np.median(xg), np.median(xe)
            sgc = xg[xg<=mg].std(); sec = xe[xe>=me].std()
            Fg_clean_mid = 0.5*(Phi((tm-mug)/sgc)+Phi((mue-tm)/sec))
            Fmid = ((xg<= (mg+me)/2).mean() + (xe > (mg+me)/2).mean())/2
            print(f"  {name:8s} Fmax={Fmax:.6f} Fmid(med)={Fmid:.6f} | gauss@tmp={Fg_emp_t:.6f} gauss@mid={Fg_mid:.6f} gaussClean@mid={Fg_clean_mid:.6f}")
